title: spermacoce neotenuis
intro: Spermacoce neotenuis, commonly known as Yellow Beggartick, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as fever, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce neotenuis include its ability to act as an antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic agent, making it a potential treatment for wounds and infections. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and may offer protection against oxidative stress and cell damage.
